Are you an engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems and discovering why products sometimes fail? Do you like combining analytical thinking with hands-on troubleshooting? Then this could be your next challenge. For an innovative technology company in the Eindhoven region, we are looking for a Electronics Failure Analysis Engineer. In this role, you investigate technical issues in advanced electronic and mechatronic products and turn your findings into concrete improvements. You will work at the intersection of engineering, quality and production. Your analysis will not only help solve individual failures, but also contribute to making future products more reliable. What will you do? As a Electronics Failure Analysis Engineer you investigate products that show unexpected behaviour or have failed during production or after being used by customers. You work methodically to determine what went wrong and, more importantly, why. Your responsibilities include: Investigating technical failures in electronic and mechatronic products and identifying their underlying causes. Performing structured failure investigations and translating technical findings into clear conclusions. Testing, measuring and troubleshooting products and components using a hands-on approach. Working closely with engineers, production and quality specialists to solve recurring technical issues. Supporting the implementation of short-term solutions to prevent defective products from entering the production process. Identifying opportunities to improve product reliability, production processes and future designs. Documenting your investigations and communicating your findings clearly to the relevant stakeholders. Contributing to continuous improvement projects across the organization. The role offers a combination of engineering, analysis and practical troubleshooting. You won't spend your entire day behind a desk: you will regularly work directly with the products and equipment you are

investigating. What can you expect? You will join an international technology environment where engineering, innovation and continuous improvement are central. In addition, you can expect: 25 paid holidays, excluding national public holidays. Flexible working hours. Free access to the company gym. Free lunch, dinner and healthy snacks at the workplace. An individual learning and development plan. Opportunities to develop yourself in different technical and project-oriented areas. A varied position with plenty of room to take ownership and develop your expertise. What do you bring? We are looking for an engineer who is naturally curious and wants to understand how and why things work. You have: A Bachelor's degree (BSc or BEng) in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Electronics or a comparable technical discipline. A structured and analytical way of approaching technical problems. A practical mindset and an interest in working directly with technical products and equipment. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. An eye for detail and the ability to distinguish symptoms from underlying causes. A proactive attitude and a strong sense of responsibility. Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively with colleagues from different disciplines. A good command of English, both written and spoken. A genuine interest in electronics, mechatronics and product reliability. Your future workplace Our client develops and manufactures advanced technology solutions used in a wide range of applications. With more than 500 different products, the organization operates across multiple technological fields and continuously invests in innovation, reliability and sustainable solutions. You will become part of an international team where engineers from different disciplines work closely together to develop and improve high-tech products. Are you ready to use your engineering skills where analysis and hands-on problem solving come together?

jobs.description:
Join Albert Heijn Online in Eindhoven as a delivery driver. Earn €18.83 gross per hour all-in from age 21, with part-time and full-time opportunities. Wat bieden wij? An all-in gross hourly wage of €18.83 from age 21. Travel allowance. Pension scheme. Holiday allowance and vacation days. The choice between weekly and four-weekly salary payments. Part-time and full-time opportunities. Morning shifts from 06:00 AM to 02:00 PM. Afternoon/evening shifts from 03:00 PM to 11:00 PM. Practical training when you start. The opportunity to join an experienced colleague during your first working days. Development and career opportunities within Albert Heijn Online and Consolid. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Eindhoven As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Eindhoven, you make sure customers receive their online grocery orders safely and on time. At the beginning of your shift, you prepare for your assigned route. You check what you need for the day, get into the delivery van and use navigation to drive to your first customer. At each address, you select the correct order from the van and carry the grocery crates to the customer's front door. You provide friendly service and make sure the groceries are handed over carefully. If there are empty crates to return, you take these back with you. Once everything is taken care of, you continue to the next customer. Your working day is a combination of driving, physical activity and customer contact. You regularly get in and out of the van, walk to customers' doors and lift grocery crates. At the same time, you have plenty of independence while completing your route through Eindhoven and the surrounding area. After your final delivery, you return to the location, complete your route and leave the van ready for the next shift. Do I need previous experience as a delivery driver? No. Previous experience as a delivery driver, courier or professional driver is not required. When you start, you will recei

practical training. During your first working days, you can join an experienced colleague and learn how the job works before completing routes independently. What are the working hours? There are two main shifts: Morning shift: 06:00 AM – 02:00 PM. Afternoon/evening shift: 03:00 PM – 11:00 PM. Both part-time and full-time opportunities are available. Do I need to work on Saturdays? You do not have to work every Saturday. However, you must be available for at least two Saturdays per month. This is a mandatory requirement for the position. Is this a physically active job? Yes. Driving is only one part of your working day. You will regularly lift and carry grocery crates, walk between the delivery van and customers' doors and get in and out of the vehicle throughout your route. You therefore need to be physically able to perform these tasks safely. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Eindhoven You have a valid category B driving licence. You are physically able to lift and carry grocery crates. You are friendly and customer-focused. You can work independently and responsibly. You have a sufficient command of Dutch and/or English. You are available for the agreed working hours. You can work at least two Saturdays per month. Previous delivery experience is not required. Would you like to combine driving with an active and varied job in Eindhoven? Apply through Consolid and start as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online. For questions about the vacancy, contact Seyyed Helal Parwiz by phone or WhatsApp at 06 83110102, or email s.parwiz@consolid.nl.

Part-time and full-time opportunities. Morning shifts from 06:00 AM to 02:00 PM. Afternoon/evening shifts from 03:00 PM to 11:00 PM. Practical training when you start. The opportunity to join an experienced colleague during your first working days. Development opportunities within Albert Heijn Online and Consolid. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Leiden As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Leiden, you make sure customers receive their online grocery orders at home. At the start of your shift, you prepare for the route ahead. Once everything is ready, you get behind the wheel of the delivery van and head towards your first customer. At each stop, you select the correct grocery order from the van and carry the crates to the customer's front door. You greet the customer, hand over the groceries and provide friendly service. If there are empty crates to return, you take these back with you. Once the delivery is complete, you continue to the next address. This is not a job where you spend your entire shift sitting behind the wheel. Throughout the day, you regularly get in and out of the van, walk to customers' homes and lift grocery crates. Driving, physical activity and customer contact are all part of the position. You complete your route independently, which means you are responsible for driving safely and handling the orders carefully. After your final delivery, you return to the location and complete your shift. Can I apply without delivery experience? Yes. Previous experience as a delivery driver, courier or professional driver is not required. During your first working days, you can join an experienced colleague. This gives you the opportunity to learn the delivery process and become familiar with the job before completing routes

independently. What are the working hours? There are two main shifts: Morning shift: 06:00 AM – 02:00 PM Afternoon/evening shift: 03:00 PM – 11:00 PM Both part-time and full-time opportunities are available. Do I need to work every Saturday? No. However, you must be available for at least two Saturdays per month. This is a mandatory requirement for the position. Is this a physically active job? Yes. In addition to driving, you will regularly carry grocery crates from the van to customers' doors. You will also be getting in and out of the vehicle throughout your route, so you need to be physically able to perform these tasks safely. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Leiden You have a valid category B driving licence. You are physically able to lift and carry grocery crates. You are friendly and customer-focused. You can work independently and responsibly. You have a sufficient command of Dutch and/or English. You are available for the agreed shifts. You can work at least two Saturdays per month. Would you like to combine driving with an active and varied job in Leiden? Apply through Consolid and start as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online. For questions about the vacancy, contact Seyyed Helal Parwiz by phone or WhatsApp at 06 83110102, or email s.parwiz@consolid.nl.

Analyse performance data to identify trends, optimise profitability, and improve retention. - 
Collaborate cross-functionally with Tech, Data, and Marketing to align operations and support scalability. - 
Represent the company at industry events and foster its reputation as a trusted, results-driven partner. - 
Maintain oversight of department KPIs, budgets, and forecasting accuracy. Requirements

As a foundation worker, you will be involved in all activities related to the production of cast-in-place piles. You will work closely with the machine operator and your colleagues on site. Safety is always a priority, and you will also be responsible for identifying any irregularities. 
You will work on various projects throughout the Netherlands. Depending on the location, your workday may start early. For projects further away, you may join the team for overnight stays. Occasional overtime may also be required to ensure the job is completed on time. What you will do - Support foundation-related activities - Assist in the production of cast-in-place piles - Work closely with the machine operator and site colleagues - Monitor safety and quality - Identify deviations and report issues 
 About the company 
Our client specializes in foundation engineering and works on a wide range of projects throughout the Netherlands. Quality, safety, and teamwork are key values within the organization. The company focuses on delivering durable solutions in construction and infrastructure.
